cards.text: Friend, Jesus has just been baptized in the Jordan, and a voice from heaven called Him God's beloved Son (Matthew 3:13-17). Then the Spirit leads Jesus out into the wilderness. Pull up a stool, because this one's a showdown.

cards.question: Why does the Spirit lead Jesus out into the wilderness?

answers.text: To be tempted by the devil

cards.text: Out there, Jesus fasts forty days and forty nights, and after that, He's hungry. Friend, if my oven timer runs two minutes long, I'm pacing circles on my gold base.
Then the tempter comes to Him and opens with a big fat IF: “If You are the Son of God…” Whoa, a voice from HEAVEN already said He is (Matthew 3:17)!

cards.question: Jesus is hungry, and the tempter points at the stones. He tells Jesus to make the stones become ___.
True or false: Jesus turns the stones into bread.
Jesus is hungry, but He doesn't make the bread. Instead, He answers the tempter with ___.

cards.text: Jesus answers, quoting Deuteronomy 8:3: “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
Round one goes to Jesus. Then the devil takes Him to the holy city and sets Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and friend, you put me near the edge of a counter and I start SWEATING.

cards.question: Up on the pinnacle of the temple, the devil tries his “If You are the Son of God…” line again. What does he dare Jesus to do?

answers.text: Make the crowds bow to Him

cards.text: And now the devil quotes Psalm 91 TOO: “He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.” Oh, so NOW he's a Bible scholar.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus answers the devil with Deuteronomy 6:16, which says not to put the Lord your God to the test.

cards.text: Then the devil takes Jesus to a very high mountain and shows Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory. Friend, for years the best view I had was the inside of a junk drawer.

cards.question: The devil offers Jesus all the kingdoms of the world and their glory. What does he want from Jesus in return?

answers.text: To fall down and worship him
To leave the land of Israel

cards.text: The devil's big offer gets shut DOWN. “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus tells him.

cards.question: Jesus sends Satan away and quotes Deuteronomy 6:13. Who does that Scripture say to worship and serve?
The devil finally leaves Jesus. Then ___ come and take care of Him.
